name: Tatsuro Taira

tale_of_tape.source: data/derived/fighters.json (67 in height, 70 in reach, Orthodox); 125 lb at the UFC 328 weigh-in (May 2026)

photo_coverage: Good for the face, thin for action. 10 photos: one freely licensed (Commons CC BY 3.0 video still, Nov 2025); studio headshot and full-body cutout (May 2026) plus a Jul 2025 cutout; a high-resolution left three-quarter (Dec 2025); left profile, three-quarter and frontal shots from the UFC 328 ceremonial weigh-in (May 8, 2026, his most recent appearance); a close frontal portrait; an older cutout that shows his forehead. No clean right profile and no photo of his standing guard.

face.shape: Long, narrow oval face that tapers to a small chin; slim, with flat cheeks and no fullness at the jaw.
face.jaw: Narrow and smoothly tapered; jaw angles soft and set high, little width at the gonial angle.
face.chin: Small, narrow and slightly pointed, moderately projecting; fairly tall from lower lip to chin tip.
face.cheekbones: Moderately prominent and wide-set relative to the narrow jaw; flat midface in the frontal view; slight hollow below at fight weight.
face.forehead: Usually hidden under a fringe; the older short-haired cutout shows a medium-height, smooth forehead with a straight hairline.

eyes.shape: Narrow almond eyes with a low or absent upper-lid crease and a small inner-corner fold; upper lids full; outer corners level to slightly raised

eyebrows.shape: Straight, nearly horizontal, fairly long, tapering at the tails
eyebrows.colour: dark brown (darker than the lightened hair)

nose.width: medium-narrow at the bridge, medium at the tip
nose.tip: Rounded, a little bulbous, pointing straight ahead; nostrils medium

face.mouth_lips: Medium-narrow mouth with full lips, the lower lip especially full; well-defined cupid's bow; the lips project slightly in profile; resting expression is a closed, slightly pouting mouth with corners turned down.

ears.cauliflower_ear: Not clearly: the right ear in the studio shots is normal; the left ear in the UFC 328 profile may have slightly thickened upper folds, but the photo is soft. Treat as normal.
ears.note: Lie fairly close to the head and are often half covered by hair.

face.notable_marks_scars: Light freckling or small spots on the cheeks (close portrait); no scars visible.

hair.style: Shaggy mushroom/mop cut: long, layered top with a heavy fringe falling to the brows, longer pieces over the tops of the ears, tapered shorter at the nape. Lightened since late 2025.
hair.colour_note: Look as of his last fight (UFC 328, May 2026): lightened hair that reads ash-blond/honey in studio flash (ESPN samples #624735 to #88664e) and dark brown with lighter streaks under arena light (#292620 to #403b32), with darker roots. #5a4535 is a mid value; add lighter streaks (#8a6a50). Natural colour (Jul and Nov 2025) is near-black brown, #1a1314; Dec 2025 (UFC 323) was a brighter bleached blond.
hair.hairline: Hidden by the fringe; straight where visible
hair.texture: Straight, fine to medium, layered and piecey

skin.tone_hex_method: plain RGB mean of the face samples marked in_average (well-lit cheeks, no specular highlight, no strong colour cast); each sample is the median of the 25th-65th luma-percentile pixels of its patch
skin.tone_hex_recommended_method: 60% face average + 40% torso (ESPN studio cutout, same lighting setup used for all four fighters in this batch), so one whole-body tint does not come out flash-pale
skin.undertone: Warm light-to-medium, peach-yellow; the lightest face of this group in arena light, though studio flash makes him sample close to Van.
skin.freckles_marks: Light freckles or small spots on the cheeks; very little body hair.
skin.note: Excluded: a shadow-edge cheek in the Jul 2025 cutout, a neck sample that fell in shadow, and the UFC 328 weigh-in photos (green-yellow stage cast). The Nov 2025 Commons still is warm indoor light but agrees with the studio cheeks.

body.build: Lean, long-limbed flyweight: 170 cm, 57 kg (125 lb) at weigh-in, long torso and long legs.
body.body_fat_note: Very lean: sharp six-pack, visible serratus and obliques, veins on the forearms.
body.shoulders: Moderate width, sloping slightly; narrower-looking than Van's
body.arms: Long and wiry; reach 178 cm (8 cm more than his height)
body.legs_calves: Long, lean thighs and slim calves
body.posture: Upright, neck long, head carried slightly forward
body.notable: Long neck; long, narrow overall proportions.

tattoos.description: none visible on the chest, abdomen, arms or legs (ESPN cutouts Jul 2025 and May 2026, UFC 328 weigh-in)

tattoos_note: Back not fully seen, but the shoulders and upper back are bare in the UFC 328 profile.

kit.fight_shorts: Standard UFC Venum shorts: white with a light-grey pattern (May 2026 cutout) or black with grey and white stripes (Jul 2025 cutout); fought UFC 328 from the blue corner (data/scouting).
kit.presser: Backwards white-and-black patterned Venum cap and patterned jacket at UFC 323

stance_and_guard.observed: No standing-guard photo was found; fight-week shots only.
stance_and_guard.arms_note: Long, thin arms (reach 178 cm); posed, his arms hang straight with the hands at mid-thigh.
stance_and_guard.style: Grappler who chains takedown attempts and hunts the back; low striking output (data/scouting/tatsuro-taira.json)

render_hints.skin_base: young_caucasian_male (the only young-age light swatch, #e6b393) tinted toward tone_hex_recommended #d38f68; middleage_asian_male (#dcb597) is an equally light alternative. Texture picked by age and swatch colour only.
render_hints.hair: a shaggy mop proxy with a full fringe, tinted #5a4535 with lighter streaks

ethnicity_fit.basis: Fitted by eye to how MakeHuman's three shape bases reproduce what the photos show: narrow almond eyes with a low or absent upper-lid crease and an inner-corner fold, a flat midface, a straight low-to-medium nasal bridge and full lips on a long, narrow face. Not assigned from name or nationality.
ethnicity_fit.confidence: low-to-medium: check a render against the ESPN headshot and the UFC 323 three-quarter; the detail morphs below are kept moderate so the sheet still works if this block is removed

morphs_if_available.note: Ear targets are not in the shipped manifest; none needed beyond defaults.

morphs_unavailable: The fringe and layered mop need a hair proxy (no morph); no target for the lid crease itself.
notes: Confidence: high for hair (cut and its colour history), the long narrow face, narrow eyes, long straight nose, full lips, absence of tattoos and the long lean build; medium for morph values; low for guard and stance details. Watch for: (1) the fringe covers the forehead down to the brows; without it he stops looking like himself; (2) pick one hair colour per scene: the lightened 2026 colour by default (#5a4535 with streaks), near-black for a 2025 look; (3) the lower face is the strongest cue: small narrow chin, full lower lip, slight pout; (4) keep him visibly taller, longer-limbed and narrower than Van (170 vs 165 cm; reach 178 vs 165 cm); (5) macro/heightDownM 0.19 comes from heightUpM = 2 * (H - 1.785 m) / 0.875 (research/assets.md); some other 170 cm sheets use 0.27, so measure the mesh and nudge it to 170 cm. ageOldM 0.027 follows avatar3d.js (26.8 - 25) / 65. The ethnicity_fit block is opt-in for avatar3d.js; drop it if the orchestrator wants the neutral thirds kept.
